Package org.apache.tomcat.dbcp.pool2.impl

Class DefaultPooledObjectInfo

java.lang.Object
org.apache.tomcat.dbcp.pool2.impl.DefaultPooledObjectInfo
All Implemented Interfaces:
DefaultPooledObjectInfoMBean
public class DefaultPooledObjectInfo extends Object implements DefaultPooledObjectInfoMBean
Implementation of object that is used to provide information on pooled objects via JMX.
